prompt: Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
